title: "Dedicating the match to SHANE WARNE" | RR vs MI - IPL 2022 | Daryl Mitchell press conference
quote_text:
Very special day for us at the royals we are going to be dedicating the match to our legend Shane Warne, any memories that you have of Shane?

I personally never got the chance to meet him in person but I was there at the MCG and I think it was 2006 I was about 15 when he got a 700th test wicket and the whole mcg was obviously full and it was an amazing experience and you had to see that live was pretty cool he's obviously one of the greats of the game and in our 1st Royal here so it's going to be a yeah an important day tomorrow and something that I know we as a playing group are really looking forward to representing who he was and what he's done for the registered royals brand

#RajasthanRoyals #ShaneWarne #IPL2022
